title: Claim Ledgers and Belief Revision
subtitle: Claim Ledgers should own the durable identity and append-only state-transition history of each material claim and its semantic variants.

display.problem: A claim can be repeated, paraphrased, narrowed, challenged, contradicted, split… disagree silently about what was asserted and why it changed.
display.insufficient: Prompts, citations, provenance graphs, vector similarity, confidence scores, self-critique, truth-maintenance… expiry, authority, and complete revision history under one executable contract.

mechanism.label: Register every candidate material
mechanism.detail: Register every candidate material claim with… extraction or registration as truth or support.

mechanism.label: Factor definitions quantifiers
mechanism.detail: Factor definitions, quantifiers, scope, population, environment, time… new semantic version or child claim.

mechanism.label: Exact equivalent entailing narrower
mechanism.detail: Represent exact, equivalent, entailing, narrower, broader, overlapping… unresolved ambiguity rather than automatic merges.

mechanism.label: Keep provenance source roles
mechanism.detail: Keep provenance, source roles, evidence refs, attacks… release as separate typed records and owners.

failures: Prose-as-database failure lets polished wording, summaries… ledger records drift or disappear.
Identity aliasing treats similar wording, embeddings… despite material scope or assumption differences.
Semantic-merge laundering collapses broader, narrower, disputed… transfers evidence or support across them.
Assumption erasure records a proposition while… make it true or useful.
proof_targets: An accepted ledger step preserves durable claim… ledger version and append count exactly once.
Stale bases, ledger self-approval, event substitution, open… incomplete custody block append or exact acknowledgment.
A reachable propose-append-materialize-acknowledge lifecycle binds exact versions… dependencies, ontology migration, residuals, and surface receipts.
